subject: HelioWorks pilot timing and next steps
messages:

To: Daniela Ruiz <daniela@helioworks.com>
Cc: Tom Lin <tom@helioworks.com>, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-01T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Scheduling a short pilot demo — availability this week?

Hi Daniela / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time on the call last week. Per our discussion I pulled together a concise 30-minute demo focused on how Redwood can reduce per-token cost for your inference-heavy enrichment pipeline and handle deployment into your VPC. Suggested agenda: 10m goals + architecture, 15m live demo, 5m next steps.

Two quick asks:
- Can you confirm which stakeholders should attend from your side? (engineering, procurement?)
- Which of these slots works for your team: Wed 10/4 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 10/5 11:00–11:30 PT?

I've attached a short solution brief and the technical appendix so your engineers can scan ahead.

Attachments: Redwood-SolutionBrief-HelioWorks.pdf (PDF), HelioWorks-Technical-Appendix.xlsx (XLSX)

If neither slot works, we can push — no problem.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: daniela@helioworks.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Lin <tom@helioworks.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T10:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Scheduling a short pilot demo — availability this week?

Hi Lauren —

Appreciate the materials and the clear agenda. I need to be direct: leadership has just reallocated headcount and shifted priorities onto a new data platform initiative for Q4. That means the LLM/inference pilot is deprioritized for at least this quarter. We also have two folks out traveling next week which would make any demo attendance awkward.

Could we pause the scheduled demo for now? I'd like to avoid taking engineering time while priorities are shifting. I expect we'll revisit in early Q1 2028 — can you mark the deal as on-hold and follow up in January?

If your team has a 5–10 minute one-pager email we can keep on file for the CTO, that would be helpful.

Thanks,
Daniela Ruiz
VP Product, HelioWorks
daniela@helioworks.com

- Would you be open to a 15-minute technical Q&A (optional) with our infra engineer the week you start the project again, instead of a full demo? We can keep it lightweight.

Monica (cc'd) will keep an eye on the account and schedule a placeholder follow-up for early Jan 2028; we can narrow an exact time later.

If helpful, here's the HubSpot deal link and I'll attach the one-pager in a follow-up.
